articles.headline: Bolivian coach says sport 'tainted' after GK death threats
articles.description: The coach of Bolivian first-division club Guabirá said his goalkeeper, Juan Manuel Ferrel, received death threats ahead of Sunday's 6-0 loss against Club Always Ready.

articles.headline: Bolivian referees suspended after playing 42 minutes added time
articles.description: Bolivia's soccer federation suspended six match officials after they added 42 minutes in a top-division league match.

articles.headline: Bolivian referee dies after collapsing on pitch
articles.description: The referee died in hospital after he collapsed during a Bolivian league match.

articles.headline: Brazilian striker Serginho walks off pitch in protest of racist chants: 'I endured up to my limit'
articles.description: Brazilian striker Serginho has condemned fans who subjected him to racist chanting during a Bolivian Primera Division match.

articles.headline: Thiago dos Santos to leave Nacional Potosi after pushing coach, says club
articles.description: Brazilian striker Thiago dos Santos will no longer play for Bolivian side Nacional Potosi after pushing his own coach during a match on Tuesday.

articles.headline: Bolivian Apertura, national team bring 2016 to an end in entertaining fashion
articles.description: Bolivia's championship comes down to a hastily arranged playoff while the national team re-hires the man they shunned. What a way to end 2016.
